<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/transfer_configurations"}
#docs
Copies the selected sections into the destination. A live destination is merge-only: catalog and coupons keep what exists, and settings, company profile, email sending, numbering and tax updates are skipped. `live_override` writes those into a live destination; it needs a signed-in owner or admin (an API key cannot grant it), the destination's exact name in `confirm`, and the `plan_digest` of a preview that still matches the destination. Never copies customers, subscriptions, invoices, payments, gateway accounts, API keys, webhooks or email templates.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `destination_business` | `string` | **yes** | The id of the business to copy the configuration to (biz_…). |
| `sections` | `array of string` | no | The sections to copy. Omitted: catalog, coupons, tax_rates and settings. |
| `wipe_destination` | `boolean` | no | True to clear the destination's existing configuration first. Test destinations only. |
| `numbering` | `object` | no | Prefixes to set on the destination. Omitted: the destination keeps its own. A prefix that another business uses, or that numbers already issued start with, is refused. |
| `numbering.invoice_prefix` | `string` | no | The destination's new invoice prefix. |
| `numbering.credit_note_prefix` | `string` | no | The destination's new credit note prefix. |
| `include_test_twins` | `boolean` | no | Both businesses live: also copy the source's test business into the destination's test business, first. |
| `live_override` | `object` | no | Write settings, company profile, email sending, numbering and tax into a live destination. Needs a signed-in owner or admin. |
| `live_override.confirm` | `string` | **yes** | The destination business's name, typed exactly. |
| `live_override.plan_digest` | `string` | **yes** | The `plan_digest` of the preview this run applies. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `transfer_configuration`. One of `transfer_configuration`. |
| `id` | `string` | The job id. |
| `status` | `string` | The job status. One of `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`. |
| `source_business` | `string` | The source business (biz_…). |
| `destination_business` | `string` | The destination business (biz_…). |
| `sections` | `array of string` | The sections copied. |
| `wipe_destination` | `boolean` | True when the destination was cleared first. |
| `options` | `object` | The `numbering` and `include_test_twins` the run was asked for. |
| `live_override` | `boolean` | True when the run used the live override. |
| `twin_of` | `string` | On a test-twin job: the id of the live job it ran with. |
| `report` | `object` | Per section: created, updated and skipped counts. |
| `error` | `string` | Why the job failed. |
| `twin` | `object` | The test-twin job that ran with this one, in the same shape. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the job started. |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the job last changed. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The transfer configuration job |
| `400` | Invalid body, a blocker, or a confirmation that is not the destination's name |
| `403` | Requires an all-mode API key; the live override needs a signed-in owner or admin |
| `404` | No such destination business |
| `409` | The destination changed after the preview, or a transfer into it is still running |
| `422` | Transfer failed |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/transfer_configurations" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "destination_business": "biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01"
  }'
```
